text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're halfway through summer camp,
and Hishi
Akebono and I have been
working hard during
training to help her
improve. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a fever, but I've hardly had
an
appetite and I feel tired all day long.
I also have
no idea what's wrong with
me, which is
concerning.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I think you might be on the
verge of heat
exhaustion...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You haven't been eating a lot lately, and
you
seem tired.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Will you be all right? It's so hot, and I'm
worried
about how little you've been
eating...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I can make you something
nutritious
and easy to digest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Just leave it to me. I can't
let
anything happen to my precious
trainer, after
all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how Hishi Akebono ends up
preparing
lunch for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay, it's ready at last! Here you go,
Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A buono dish from Chef Bono! ☆ I call it

"Refreshing ☆ Somen Noodles"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I mixed in summer veggies, condiments,
soup, and
canned mackerel with the
easy-to-slurp noodles!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And this is another buono dish from Chef
Bono!
Here we have a summer-themed
dish of grilled
meat and veggies in soup
stock! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The pork is nice and crispy, I grilled the
summer
vegetables fast so they stayed
crunchy, and I
made the chilled soup
with soy sauce, mirin, and
bonito stock.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Pork is supposed to help prevent heat

exhaustion, so make sure you eat it all
up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're super welcome! Now go on and
try it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still don't have much of an appetite, so
I try to
awaken it again with a couple of
mouthfuls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The soup base and canned mackerel
give the
noodles an exquisite taste, and
the chilled
veggies and condiments
complement them both
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment the fragrant pork and
vegetables
from the second dish touch
my tongue, the gentle
taste of the soup
lifts all tension from my body.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I'm glad you like it! Eat up so you
can feel
better soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono prepares a few more
meals for me
after that, and thanks to
her efforts, I'm back at
full health in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's just like Hishi Akebono to do
what she
wants without any hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I struggle to come up with any ideas
myself, so I
end up asking her directly
what she'd like.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want to repay my kindness?
Come on,
you don't owe me or anything!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you think so? I don't really see it
that way,
but... Let's see...
choice_data_list: Because you're always helping me out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I would like to watch a fireworks show with you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how we end up going to a
fireworks
show.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eep! There are sooo many people here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I might get squished by
everyone
before the fireworks even
start! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono looks like she's enjoying
herself
regardless, but I do feel like
there might be a
little too many people
around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We might be better off finding another
spot, but
the show's about to start. What
should we do?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's do that. I'll probably forget
about all
these people when the
fireworks start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We wait leisurely amidst the crush of
people, and
before long the fireworks
start launching up into
the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shoooom... BAM!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're so pretty! Look how big
that one is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I crane my neck up to see as the cheers
rise, but
the people in front of me are so
tall, and it's so
crowded, that I can't
make out very much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But just when I resign myself to missing
out...
choice_data_list: (Well, as long as Akebono is happy...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Someone picks me up and hoists me
onto their
shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Is it easier to see from up there?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's great! Aren't the fireworks big and
pretty?
choice_data_list: I-I see it, I see it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I really wanted you to see the
fireworks
too, you know, since it's
summer and everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks so happy that I can't bring
myself to tell
her I'd like to be put back
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But at the very least, I manage to make
a
wonderful summer camp memory with
Hishi
Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You want to find a different spot? I guess it is pretty crowded here...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's find somewhere we can
stretch out
and relax more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a hurry to relocate, we head toward
the beach
where we usually train.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's pitch-black! But I bet we'll
have an
amazing view from out here on
the beach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's sit over there and watch the show.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I couldn't see where I was going
and
tripped. I'm okay, though!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She does seem fine, but I don't want her
to keep
stumbling as we walk. Without
even thinking, I
hold my hand out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: R-right.
choice_data_list: Because it'd be dangerous if you fell again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Usually I'm the one people hold
on to,
you know, since I'm so big.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of embarrassing this way
around...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We reach our new viewing spot without
any more
tumbles, then sit and gaze up
at the fireworks. I
feel as if our memories
of tonight will last a
lifetime.
